title: Depression years, the WPA band, his 1934 marriage and the return of beer
summary: Ferbos played in the WPA band through the Depression, married in 1934 while with Pichon, and played with Handy when beer returned.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Yeah, I was trying to remember, because I know I had seen you in the street quite a few times. Yeah, that's right. To get all this straightened out in my head, were you playing before depression?
Oh, definitely, because I worked at the WPA band all during depression.
Were you playing gigs on the side, when you were playing with the WPA band?
Yeah. They never had many gigs on the side.
No jobs. They didn't have many. Yeah, well you played at Popeyes with Harold around that time.
Well yeah, but I don't think I was on the third period then when I played at Popeyes. That was before that.
That was before that. Yeah, that was before that.

And even, well I know that because when we worked at the lake, I was newly married. And it's like when I was 18 I was newly married. That was before depression. In fact it was all building up, you know, but it wasn't definitely considered depression, you see, because when it really got there you could hardly get a job. You might play a gig occasionally, but it wasn't too many.
What year did you get married in? 1934. 1934. And what band were you playing with when you got married?
And who were you playing with when beer came back? Do you remember that?
Yeah, I played with Andy when the beer came back.
We're getting those dates straightened out.

Yeah, we all the way with Andy because we played on Common or Gravity Street. Are they served? No. Some place there in the middle of the block. And the beer was legalized again. It had something to do over there. I think it was with Hand out there.
On Gravity Street? Yeah. Wasn't it all going around the corner between Ramport and Drunk?
No, it wasn't between Ramport. It was between Rowan and Carondale or somewhere around there. Or somewhere. Yeah, it was some restaurant and beer place.
